findings.title: Stable Channel Update for Desktop (Chrome 151.0.7922.108/.109, 41 security fixes)
findings.summary_md: Google's Chrome Releases blog published the desktop Stable channel advisory for 151.0.7922.108/.109 (Windows/Mac) and 151.0.7922.108 (Linux) on August 6, 2026, listing 41 security fixes, six of them critical use-after-free or out-of-bounds-write bugs in WebGL, Aura, Skia, ANGLE, and Views. CVE-2026-19137 (use after free in WebGL, issue 499602793) was reported anonymously on 2026-04-05; CVE-2026-19170 (use after free in WebGL, issue 537729021) was reported on 2026-07-22 by Muhammad Alifa Ramdhan, Pan ZhenPeng, and Billy Jheng Bing Jhong of STAR Labs SG Pte. Ltd. The advisory warns that access to bug details may stay restricted until a majority of users are updated; issue 537729021 still requires sign-in on the Chromium issue tracker.
